headline: Wall Street has its worst drop since the Covid-19 pandemic
summary: US stock indexes posted their sharpest falls since the Covid-19 pandemic. Anthropic shares closed slightly below $89 on Friday, giving it a market value of $1.17 trillion.
why: US equity indexes such as the S&P 500 are the main benchmarks for global equity risk, and a broad selloff affects portfolios worldwide.
why_moved: Technology stocks were sold heavily, and the article describes the sell-off as the largest for US indexes since the pandemic.
original_headline: Wall Street tiene su peor caída desde la pandemia del Covid-19
